overall: The AG found the Norwell School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law when Chair McEachern read a prepared statement on topics not listed on the December 15, 2025 notice, rejecting the "School Committee Member Reports" heading as sufficiently specific and rejecting the argument that correcting falsehoods or Robert's Rules excused it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee discussed a topic at its Dec 15, 2025 meeting that was not listed with sufficient specificity on the meeting notice.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
